test_title: PYST 31: SSC MTS - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: The simple interest on a sum of Rs. 4,800 for 4(1)/(2) years at a certain rate per annum is Rs. 1,684.80, What will be the amount of the same sum at the same rate for 6 (2)/(3) years at simple interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Simple interest on Rs.4800 for 4(1)/(2) years = Rs.1684.80

**Formulas used:**

Simple Interest = Principal × Rate/100 × Time 

Amount = Principal + Simple interest 

**Calculation:**

Simple interest = 1684.80 

⇒ 4800 × 4(1)/(2) × Rate/100 = 1684.80 

⇒ Rate = 1684.80/(24 × 9)

⇒ Rate = 7.8%

Amount for 6 (2)/(3) years = Principal + Simple interest 

⇒ 4800 + 4800 × 6 (2)/(3) × 7.8%

⇒ 4800 + 4800 × 20/3 × 78/1000 

⇒ 4800 + 2496 

⇒ 7296 

**∴ The required amount = Rs.7296**
